subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinMech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@finmech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Thanks again for taking the demo today, Tom — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and owners.

Summary of what we covered
- Scope: Inference for transaction categorization and natural-language customer inquiry routing.
- Key asks from FinMech: sub-second latency for prioritised queries, 95% precision on top-1 categorization for the 10 core transaction types, and clear audit logs for all API calls.

Proposed POC (4 weeks total)
1) Week 0 (prep, 3-5 days)
   - Access: Provide sandbox API key + sample dataset upload instructions (Redwood)
   - Security: Exchange basic controls and execute NDA as needed (FinMech / Redwood)
2) Week 1-2 (integration & validation, 10 workdays)
   - Integration: Connect sample dataset, run 10k transactions through sandbox, establish baseline metrics
   - Ownership: FinMech engineering lead (Tom) + Redwood SE (Dylan)
3) Week 3 (optimization & edge cases)
   - Tune prompts/quant profiles, enable prefix caching for test workload
   - Deliver: Updated metrics and short runbook for production rollout
4) Week 4 (review & decision)
   - Final report vs success criteria, executive readout, next steps for Dedicated deployment or Hosted API

Success criteria (please confirm or edit)
- >=95% top-1 precision on the 10 core transaction types on the validation set
- Median latency <300ms for typical query mix (p95 <500ms)
- All inference requests logged with request id and input substring for auditability
- Integration completed with sample dataset and two test endpoints

Next steps / asks for FinMech
- Confirm success criteria or propose edits by EOD Thu 3/4
- Provide a technical contact for data onboarding + any compliance attachments you need (SOC2, DPA)
- Tentative POC kickoff week of 3/9 - Ok for your team?

Attachments: finmech-poc-success-criteria.pdf (outline), redwood-poc-technical-checklist.xlsx
Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-finmech-poc-plan

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to lock scope.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa - good demo. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the 95% top-1 precision is reasonable but we need to make sure it holds on our historical data (including noisy OCR records). Can you confirm the validation process and whether Redwood will run the baseline on our full anonymized sample?
2) Data & access: we'll need details on how data is stored/retained in the sandbox, and whether API keys are scoped or time-limited. Also need to confirm we can bring encryption keys (we prefer customer-managed keys).
3) Compliance: our security team will send a brief questionnaire - who should that go to?

If possible, please include a proposed kickoff agenda for week of 3/9 and estimate of Redwood SE time commitment (hours/week). Also cc'ing Leah (engineering) who will be working with Dylan on the integration.

Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Director of Data & Analytics, FinMech
tom.h@finmech.com | +1 212 555 0199

Hi Tom/Leah - quick answers inline and a proposed kickoff agenda attached.

1) Validation process: Redwood can run the baseline on your anonymized sample in the sandbox. We'll sign a DPA/NDA as needed and provide an isolated project with time-limited API keys. For OCR/noisy inputs we recommend a 10% augmentation of real data (we can help synthesize).

2) Data & keys: Sandbox data will be encrypted at rest. We support customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations for Private deployments; for Hosted sandbox we can enable time-limited scoped keys. I'll ask our security contact to follow up on the exact retention policy (standard sandbox retention is 30 days by default).

3) Compliance questionnaire: send it to security@redwood.com - cc'd here (SECC).

Proposed kickoff agenda (Wed 3/10 morning or Mon 3/9 afternoon)
- 15m intros & success criteria sign-off
- 30m technical onboarding: sample data format, API key, endpoints
- 30m run-through of baseline test and quick run
- 15m next steps and owners

SE commitment: Dylan (Redwood SE) will dedicate ~8-10 hours/week during the integration & validation phase and be available for async support otherwise.

I've attached: redwood-poc-technical-checklist.xlsx and a short kickoff slide deck.

Let me know which day/time works and if you can send the security questionnaire to security@redwood.com.

Best,
Marissa
